title: Functional genomics of B cell activation pathways in autoimmunity
description: This study provides a comprehensive multi-omics resource of human B cell activation. We obtained B cells from 27 healthy female donors and stimulated them in vitro with six activation conditions targeting key pathways: the B cell receptor (BCR), Toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7), TLR9, CD40, and a cocktail that promotes differentiation into double negative 2 (DN2) IgD_ CD27_ CD11c+ CD21- B cells, a likely pathogenic subset implicated in autoimmunity and infection. We profiled these stimulated cells and unstimulated controls across multiple time points using RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq (snRNA-seq) with surface protein markers (CITE-seq), and ATAC-seq.
